name: colourful-text
blurb: Each character cycles through a rainbow palette and bounces with staggered timing.
description: Renders each character with motion animations including color cycling from a 10-color palette, subtle vertical bounce, scale pulse, and blur effect. Colors reshuffle every 5 seconds.
use_when: A playful heading wants maximum vibrancy and visual interest with per-character color animation.
avoid_when: Professional or corporate contexts where muted colors are required.
a11y: Characters are rendered as individual spans but content is readable and in DOM order.
